headline: EU and Bhutan Sign Trade Pact in Thimphu
summary: European Union foreign ministers signed a trade and tourism agreement with Bhutan during a summit in Thimphu, marking the bloc's first comprehensive accord with the Himalayan nation. The deal includes a $200 million development assistance package over five years.
key_points: EU and Bhutan signed a trade pact worth $200 million over five years
The agreement covers tourism, sustainable development, and digital trade
European Council president Antonio Costa announced the deal in Thimphu
The pact represents Bhutan's first comprehensive accord with the EU

source_documents.title: Joint EU-Bhutan Summit Communique on Trade and Tourism
